DIAGNOSIS READY: Varicella (Chickenpox)

The clinical presentation of painless, pruritic papules with a reported "dewdrop on a rose petal" appearance, combined with recent exposure to an active case in daycare and a sibling with chickenpox, is highly characteristic of Varicella, even in an immunized child who may have had a breakthrough infection or an incomplete vaccine response. The CBC results are likely normal or show mild leukocytosis, which supports a viral etiology rather than a bacterial infection or malignancy.
